label: Rule-composition resource contract
title: What could composing rules actually buy?
summary: A repeated three-rule schedule and its own fused radius-three CA give exactly the same outputs every three steps. Selected saved tables show both Rule-30-first fused maps genuinely need radius three.
takeaway: Any benefit must have an intermediate-read or physical-resource contract, with clock, storage, locality and access costs charged fairly. Composition applications are parked until a consumer exists.
